examples.solution_text:
$x=(y-2)^2+3$
Choose the positive root because $y\ge2$.
$f^{-1}(x)=2+\sqrt{x-3},\ x\ge3$

examples.question_text:
Find the inverse function of each of these.
a) $f(x)=7-4x$
b) $f(x)=2x^{3}+9$
c) $f(x)=\frac{5}{x-8}$, $x\ne8$
Find the inverse function of $f(x)=\sqrt{x-11}+4$. State the domain of the inverse.
examples.solution_text:
The original range is $y\ge4$, so the inverse domain is $x\ge4$.
$y=\sqrt{x-11}+4$
$x=\sqrt{y-11}+4$
$x-4=\sqrt{y-11}$
$(x-4)^{2}=y-11$
$f^{-1}(x)=(x-4)^{2}+11$, $x\ge4$.

examples.question_text:
A one-to-one function $f$ has $f(8)=19$ and $f(-4)=7$. Find:
a) $f^{-1}(19)$
b) $f^{-1}(7)$
examples.solution_text:
The inverse reverses each input and output.
a) $f(8)=19$, so $f^{-1}(19)=8$.
b) $f(-4)=7$, so $f^{-1}(7)=-4$.
